title: Standard operating procedures
description: The lab's procedures, version by version. Everyone signs the version in effect.

toSign.label: For you to sign
toSign.hint: Versions in effect you have not signed

caption: Procedures
emptyBody: Quality assurance writes the lab's procedures here; staff read and sign each version in effect.

form.title: Write a procedure
form.description: Version 1 is saved as a draft. It takes effect once it is approved.
form.name: Title
form.bodyHint: Purpose, scope, materials and the steps, or a summary when you attach the document.

actions.draftDescription: Staff keep following the version in effect until this one is approved.
actions.changeNoteHint: Shown in the history and to staff who sign it.
actions.approveBody: It takes effect now and replaces the version in effect. Every member will need to sign it. You will be asked for your password: approving is an electronic signature.
actions.approved: The new version is in effect
actions.signBody: By signing, you confirm you have read and understood this procedure, and its document when there is one, and will follow it. You will be asked for your password: this is an electronic signature.
actions.signConfirm: I have read and understood it
actions.attachDescription: The controlled document as the lab keeps it. It is frozen with the version once approved.
actions.fileHint: PDF or Word, up to 10 MB. Attaching again replaces the draft's document.

detail.inEffect: Version {version} in effect since {date}, approved by {name}.
detail.notInEffect: No version is in effect yet: the draft needs approval.
detail.toSign: Please read version {version} and sign it.
detail.deviationsHint: Incidents recorded as departures from this procedure.
